d:BackstoryDef/HH_Creator_HarbourTinkere: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up between the cargo cranes of a small harbour town, taking apart whatever the dockworkers threw away and putting it back together a little better than before.\n\nThe innkeeper next door paid [PAWN_objective] in pie to fix the creaking doors, and [PAWN_pronoun] learned early that a warm room and a full plate turn strangers into friends.
d:BackstoryDef/HH_Creator_WanderingInnke: [PAWN_nameDef] never stayed anywhere for long. With a toolbox, a battered recipe book and far too many plans, [PAWN_pronoun] wandered the rim building inns, banks and little infirmaries for whoever needed one - then handed over the keys and moved on.\n\nSettlers along the trade roads still tell of the stranger who fixed their roof, cooked them dinner and was gone before anyone could pay. Somewhere out there, [PAWN_pronoun] is still building something for someone else.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Boomalo: Slow-cooked in its own fat. Do not stand next to the pot. Traditionally made from boomalope, carefully.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Campfir: Everything went into the pot, including the argument about what everything meant. Traditionally made from muffalo.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_ClayOve: Marinated overnight, blasted in a clay oven and served with arrogance. Traditionally made from muffalo.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Dromeda: Slow-cooked in a clay cone, like most people wish to be. Traditionally made from dromedary.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Lacquer: Glazed until it shines brighter than the colony's bank account. Traditionally made from thrumbo, if the colony is that lucky.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_LambKof: Spiced, shaped and served over rice like a very tasty lecture. Traditionally made from lamb.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Mongoli: Wok-fried, sweet, sticky and a bit too loud. Traditionally made from muffalo.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Muffalo: Braised in beer, because the wine ran out on the second day. Traditionally made from muffalo.
Sliced thin enough to read the menu through it. Traditionally made from muffalo.
Red, thick, and officially the unofficial national argument. Traditionally made from muffalo.
Slurp loudly. In a fight for the last bowl, slurp even louder. Traditionally made from muffalo.
Creamy, rich and gone by the third spoon. Traditionally made from muffalo.
Wrapped in pastry, a tiny insulation for a very grand ego. Traditionally made from muffalo.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_PadThru: A sweet-sour tangle of noodles and crunch, wok-fired until it behaves. The crunch comes from insect meat.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Thrumbo: A clear broth with a very long to-do list behind it. Traditionally made from thrumbo, if the colony is that lucky.
Raw, fierce and brave. Sign the waiver first. Traditionally made from thrumbo, if the colony is that lucky.
d:PawnColumnDef/SL_Insurance.label: insurance
d:ScenPartDef/HH_ScenRules.description: Sets modules, hosting difficulty, content intensity and any per-colony setting of Hearth & Harbor and Silverline for new colonies of this scenario. Only what is set here overrides the template; the player can still change everything on the storyteller page.
d:ScenPartDef/HH_ScenRules.label: Hearth & Harbor rules
d:ScenPartDef/HH_ScenSetting.description: Sets one Hearth & Harbor or Silverline setting to a value for new colonies of this scenario.
d:ScenPartDef/HH_ScenSetting.label: Hearth & Harbor setting
d:ScenPartDef/HH_ScenStartingResearch.de: A Hearth & Harbor or Silverline research project is already finished when the colony starts.
d:ScenPartDef/SL_ScenStartingAccount.des: The colony starts with an account at a bank of your choice, an opening balance and, if you like, a loan to pay off.
d:Silverline.SL_ClaimFormDef/SL_ClaimFor: Form L-1 for fines, damage to third parties and closures: what caused it and who can confirm it.
Form P-2 for deaths and lost limbs: the circumstances and a witness.
Form B-4 for destroyed buildings, vehicles and crops: what happened, how bad it was, who saw it and how you want to be paid.
d:SongDef/HH_Song_HarborMorning.descript: A bright acoustic morning by the water. Spring and summer days.
d:SongDef/HH_Song_HarborMorning.label: Harbor Morning
d:SongDef/HH_Song_LanternsAtTheInn.descr: Warm lights in the common room while the leaves turn. Autumn.
d:SongDef/HH_Song_LanternsAtTheInn.label: Lanterns at the Inn
d:SongDef/HH_Song_SnowOnTheSign.descript: Quiet snowfall over the inn sign, the fire still burning inside. Winter.
d:SongDef/HH_Song_SnowOnTheSign.label: Snow on the Sign
d:StorytellerDef/HH_Hetty.description: Hetty runs the friendliest waystation on the rim and wants yours to thrive. Raids come rarely and gently, bad luck stays mild and good fortune knocks often: traders, travellers, wanderers who want to stay, and plenty of guests.\n\nFor players who want to build. On the higher difficulties she still pushes back, just kindly. Anomaly threats follow the Anomaly settings as usual, while its eerie side events come more rarely. Animals never fall ill under her care.
d:StorytellerDef/HH_Hetty.label: Hetty Hearthwell
d:ThingDef/HH_Mote_Bell.label: night bell
d:ThingDef/HH_Mote_RingArc.label: ring
d:ThoughtDef/HH_GuestPreached.stages.0.d: I came here to sleep, not to be talked out of my beliefs.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_ServedBusy.stages.0.desc: Guests kept coming to the counter and I had something to do the whole time. That is how work should feel.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_ServedBusy.stages.1.desc: One guest after the other. I knew every order before they finished asking. A good kind of tired.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_ServedBusy.stages.2.desc: The whole room wanted something at once and I kept up with all of it. I'm proud of that shift.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_ServedIdle.stages.0.desc: I stood behind the counter for ages and nobody came. I polished the same glass three times.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_ServedIdle.stages.1.desc: Hours at the counter with nothing to do. I could have been doing something useful.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_ServedIdle.stages.2.desc: An entire shift of waiting for guests who never came. What am I even standing here for?
d:ThoughtDef/HH_SleptTogether.stages.0.d: One big bed for the two of us. That is all I wanted from this trip.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_WantedDoubleBed.stages.0: We asked for one bed for the two of us and got two narrow ones. Cosy it is not.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_WokenByBell.stages.0.des: Somebody rang the bell in the middle of my sleep. Duty calls. Loudly.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_WokenByBell.stages.1.des: Somebody rang the bell in the middle of my sleep. Well, that is the job. I will sleep later.
